method: Read-only PostgreSQL transaction; global event type aggregates and synthetic organization notification aggregates, without payloads or recipients
interpretation: Outbox backlog is not an undelivered notification count. Current V8.1 result handlers insert notifications directly in business transactions.
risk: Outbox consumption and retention lifecycle remain unverified; do not mark events processed or purge them just to remove the backlog.
followup: cloud-notification-auth.json records current notification ownership, read replay, preferences restore and session revocation checks. These are not proof of every notification trigger or UI rendering.
